ἀθῷος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι) (meaning a penalty);
ἀθῷος.as:
ἀθῷος (Rec. wrongly, -ῶος; LS, s.v.; Mayser, 131), -ον
(< θωή, a penalty), [in LXX chiefly for נקה ni., pi., נָקִי;]
1.unpunished (MM, VGT, s.v.).
2.innocent: Mt 27:4 (WH, R, mg., δίκαιον) 27:24.

ἀθετέω.long: I annul, make of no effect, set aside, ignore, slight; I break faith with.
ἀθετέω.sd: to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate
ἀθετέω.kj: cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject
ἀθετέω.der: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);
ἀθετέω.as:
† ἀθετέω, -ῶ
(< τίθημι), [in LXX for seventeen different words, פּשׁע, מרד, בּגד, מעל, etc., often meaning, as I Ki 13:3 (Heb., al.), to revolt; properly, to makeἄθετον, or do away with what has been laid down (v. DCG, i, 453 f.)].
1.to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην, Ga 3:16; ἐντολήν, Mk 7:9; νόμον, He 10:28; πίστιν, I Ti 5:12.
2.to nullify, make void: Lk 7:30 (v. Field, Notes, 59), I Co 1:19, Ga 2:21.
3.to reject: Mk 6:26 (Field, op. cit., 30), Lk 10:16, Jo 12:48, I Th 4:8, Ju 8 (for exx. in π., v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἀθροίζω.as:
ἀθροίζω
(< ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, VGT, s.v.; < θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX chiefly for קבץ;]
to gather, assemble: Lk 24:33.†

ἀθέμιτος.sd: from the base of G5087 (τίθημι)); illegal; by implication, flagitious
ἀθέμιτος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (statute;
ἀθέμιτος.as:
** ἀ-θέμιτος (late form of ἀθέμιστος, LS, MM, VGT, s.v.), -ον
(< θέμις, custom, right), [in LXX: II Mac 6:57:110:34, III Mac 5:20*;]
(a) of persons, lawless (III Mac 5:20);
(b) of things, lawless, unlawful: Ac 10:28, I Pe 4:3.†
SYN.: v.s. ἄθεσμος.

Ἀθῆναι.long: Athens, the intellectual capital of Greece.
Ἀθῆναι.der: plural of (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city);
Ἀθῆναι.as:
Ἀθῆναι, -ῶν, αἱ (plural because consisting of several parts),
Athens: Ac 17:15, 1618:1, I Th 3:1.†

Ἀθηναῖος.sd: an Athenæan or inhabitant of Athenæ

ἀθανασία.der: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2288 (θάνατος);
ἀθανασία.as:
** ἀθανασία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἀ-θάνατος, undying; V. MM, VGT, s.v.), [in LXX: Wi 3:44:18:13, 1715:3, IV Mac 14:516:13*;]
immortality: I Co 15:53, 54I Ti 6:16 (cf. Cremer, 285 f.).†

ἄθεος.long: without god, without (the only true) God, godless.
ἄθεος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2316 (θεός);
ἄθεος.as:
* ἄ-θεος, -ον,
1. in cl.
(a)slighting or denying the gods (Plat.; cf. MM, VGT, s.v.);
(b)godless, ungodly (Pind.);
(c)abandoned by the gods (Soph.)
2. In the NT (cf. Lft. on Ign. ad Trail, §3), of the heathen, without God, not knowing God (Cremer, 281): Eph 2:12.†

ἀθυμέω.long: I lose heart, am despondent, am disheartened.
ἀθυμέω.der: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2372 (θυμός);
ἀθυμέω.as:
ἀθυμέω, -ῶ (ἄ-θυμος, without heart),
[in LXX for חרה, etc.;]
to be disheartened: Col 3:21.†

ἀθλέω.long: I engage, compete, in an (athletic) contest.
ἀθλέω.sd: to contend in the competitive games
ἀθλέω.der: from (a contest in the public lists);
ἀθλέω.as:
* ἀθλέω, -ῶ (in cl. also ἀθλεύω, < ἆθλος, a contest, in war or in sport),
to contend in games, wrestle, combat: II Ti 2:5.†

ἀθέτησις.as:
† ἀθέτησις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀθετέω), [in LXX, usually of unfaithful, rebellious action: I Ki 24:12 (פֶּשַׁע), Je 12:1 (בֶּגֶד), Da TH 9:7 (מַעַל), II Mac 14:28*;]
a disannulling, setting aside: He 7:189:26 (for similar usage in π., v. Deiss., BS, 228 f.; MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἄθλησις.long: a struggling (as in an athletic contest).
ἄθλησις.as:
*† ἄθλησις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀθλέω),
a contest, combat, esp. of athletes; fig., a struggle: He 10:32 (for exx., v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

ἄθεσμος.der: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι) (in the sense of enacting);
ἄθεσμος.as:
**† ἄθεσμος, -ον
(< θεσμός, law, custom), [in LXX: III Mac 5:126:26*;]
lawless, esp. of those who violate the law of nature and conscience (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.): II Pe 2:73:17.†
SYN.: ἀθέμιτος, ἄνομος, κακός, πονηρός, φαῦλος (v. Tr., Syn., §lxxiv; DCG, ii, 821b).
